history.overview: The Frontlines mark the Muramite Legion’s forward assault position, where resistance enclaves fight desperately to hold ground.

timeline.name: Frontline Establishment
timeline.description: Muramite forces seized the outer battlefield and established trenches.

timeline.name: Resistance Counterattacks
timeline.description: Resistance enclaves launched repeated counterattacks to reclaim ground.

timeline.name: Discord Fissures
timeline.description: Planar ruptures appeared across the frontlines, warping terrain.

timeline.name: Stalemate
timeline.description: The frontlines became a perpetual war zone with no clear victor.
